sanitizedJustification: Every raw hit is static CodeQL js/session-fixation help, duplicated as markdown/text and pretty JSON/raw API response. Decoded-string inspection also identifies js/jwt-missing-verification teaching examples. None is a measured application secret, source artifact credential or actual SARIF finding. The real SARIF results remain separate and unmodified.
scopeLimit: This disposition covers these exact four SARIF member hashes and reviewed nested logs only. It does not dismiss CodeQL alerts, modify patterns, or certify all repository/CI data by inference.

scannerCoverage.originalV2Behavior: Top-level ZIP/TAR/GZIP members are scanned as text; nested compressed members are not recursively decompressed by v2.
